## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `PromotionApprovals`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `promotion-approval`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **PromotionApprovals**.

## Step 2: Enable the promotion approval workflow

1. <!-- manual: In the top navigation, click your organization name to switch to the organization level. -->
2. <!-- manual: In the left navigation, go to Admin › Settings. -->
3. On the **Settings** page, select **Workflows**.
4. <!-- manual: In the Environment Promotion row, click the toggle to enable the workflow. -->
5. <!-- manual: In the opened Configure Workflow dialog, specify who can review promotion requests. :::info You can also update these settings later by clicking the edit icon next to the workflow toggle. ::: -->
6. Select **Save**.

## Step 3: Request to promote

1. <!-- manual: Open your integration from the project home. -->
2. On the integration overview page, select **Request to Promote** below the environment card. The **Request Approval** drawer opens.
3. <!-- manual: Optionally, type a message for the reviewer. -->
4. Select **Submit**.

## Step 4: Review a promotion request

1. <!-- manual: In the top navigation, click your organization name to switch to the organization level. -->
2. <!-- manual: In the left navigation, go to Admin › Approvals. -->
3. <!-- manual: On the Pending tab, locate the promotion request and click Review. The Review Details panel opens, showing the project name, integration name, source and target environments, build, and the requester's message. -->
4. <!-- manual: Optionally, type a comment. -->
5. Select **Approve** or **Reject**.
